built_by: hand-built (pinbu_wave.py plan ranks a delivery group on f_r and cannot request an f_xy-ranked set nor an unlabelled F_r-era replay set; same schema, same _score serve path, same run path)
model_note: s1j is the campaign's OWN serving champion (11th champion, arm-3 direct f_xy head).  G4 FAILED, so fxy_head.serve_sigma is BARRED: predicted_f_xy is pinned, its sigma is NOT served.
f_xy_note: f_xy is NOT on WaveFom; the replay's f_xy is read OFFLINE from the retained MAS_OUT (keep_success=true) with the same FXYP scanner that produced data/reports/fxy_backfill_199_pinbu_wave_fxyera_r1_20260830.csv, then compared to stored.f_xy pinned here (minfxy_r1_top20) or reported as a FIRST label (frera_fxy_measure, whose stored.f_xy is null by construction).

provenance_plan.policy: RESOLVED AT PLAN TIME.  A row is eligible only if its stored restart_provenance is native:, i.e. it resolves out of the design package and NOT out of data/produce/promoted.  This closes the failure that refused 8/40 on pinbu_wave_fxyera_r1 (results 20260830 sec.1): the promoted cache had GROWN, so pair_ecore:/pair_feed: rows resolved promoted: restarts and were refused.  With 0 pair_* and 0 promoted: targets there is no promoted-cache state, grown or pruned, that can move a resolution.  All 14 native: targets of that wave resolved correctly under exactly the cache growth that broke the other 8.

groups.name: minfxy_r1_top20

groups.name: frera_fxy_measure
groups.selection: the F_r-era record core 4d70ab6f (F_r 1.4605, batchswap_enum_T6T4) and the lambda-opt 188c9a33 (F_r 1.4749, fpcamp_minfr_T6T4_r8), plus the 3 next lowest-F_r joint-clean UNLABELLED (f_xy null) cores of the same T6_T4/f121/paramA cell, excluding every F_xy-era campaign; tie-break record_id.
groups.purpose: measure F_xy on the F_r-record family.  These 5 rows carry NO f_xy label (results sec.11.3, 'the registered unknown'), so this arm produces FIRST labels, not replicates -- its determinism contribution is on f_r/f_q/cbc_max/cyclen only.
